entries.speaker: What to Do Next
entries.en: When you have some free time and don't know[n]what to do next, press [f 1 10 66] to open the [clr 2]Assist[n]Command[clr 27] to view what you can do and who[n]you can see.

entries.speaker: What to Do Next
entries.en: If [clr 2]Network Functions are ON[clr 27], you can use [f 1 10 42][n]to view the [clr 2]Activity Log[clr 27]. This will enable you to[n]see what other players did on this day in the calendar.

entries.speaker: What to Do Next
entries.en: The [clr 2]Activity Log[clr 27] is a support tool that can assist[n]you during your free time. If you would like to[n]know more about it, check the corresponding[n][clr 2]Tutorial[clr 27].
